name: Tettra
description: Tettra is an AI-powered internal knowledge base that helps teams organize company information and answer repetitive questions directly inside Slack, reducing interruptions and keeping documentation current.
best_for: Positioned for startups and growing companies, customer support teams, agencies, and HR/operations teams that want to eliminate repetitive questions and bottlenecked subject-matter experts.
features: AI-powered Q&A bot (Kai) that answers questions from Slack or Tettra using existing content
Slack integration that embeds the knowledge base into channels and direct messages
Import of existing content from Google Docs, Notion, and PDFs
Knowledge management automation for subject-matter-expert verification of page accuracy
Search across the full knowledge base
